# STE fixtures: real study clips (compact derivative)

> [Русская версия](README_RU.md)

A compact derivative of 19 real STE clips. The sources (`data/dicom/For_pero`)
live in the **private** repository `areatu/Sonoforge_data` (the frames contain
burned-in names); only the de-identified export is here, so the folder is public
and regular (not Git LFS — see the exceptions in `.gitattributes`).

## Contents

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `<clip>.npz` | All clip frames as JPEG + analysis metadata (frame count, fps, pixel spacing) |
| `<clip>.json` | Stripped DICOM header digest, including private tags with vendor strain values |
| `ui_reference/*.png` | Screenshots of vendor STE screens (Samsung/Philips) for visual cross-checking |
| `index.json` | Fixture inventory (source, clip list, geometry) |
| `_diagnostics.md` | Diagnostics of the last CI export (regenerated by the workflow) |

## Clips

- `gold1…gold6`, `gold7+ECG`, `gold8+ECG` — Samsung RS85 (gold clips, some with ECG);
- `gold_Ph_ECG1/2`, `strain_ph1…3` — Philips;
- `strain_sams1…6` — Samsung "3 Point Contour" screens with vendor values.

## Regeneration

The [`ste-fixtures.yml`](../../../.github/workflows/ste-fixtures.yml) workflow runs
[`tools/ste_fixture_export.py`](../../../tools/ste_fixture_export.py) on a runner with
access to the private data repository (secret `SONOFORGE_DATA_TOKEN`) and commits the
result back. Manually (requires a clone of the private repository):

```bash
python tools/ste_fixture_export.py \
    --source /path/to/Sonoforge_data/data/dicom/For_pero \
    --out tests/fixtures/for_pero
```

Fixture contract tests: [`tests/unit/test_ste_real_clips.py`](../../unit/test_ste_real_clips.py)
(skipped when the fixtures are not present in the checkout).
